RUINA2-THE_PIANIST.title: The Pianist
RUINA2-THE_PIANIST.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
The city [jitter][red]shudders[/red][/jitter], vibrating like a plucked string. The grand [gold]performance[/gold] stretches ever outward, curling around the minds of its victims like a slowly tightening noose.

You try to fight it. You try to beat back those notes ringing in your skull, those beats pounding away at your mind. And in the end, you -.
RUINA2-THE_PIANIST.pages.RETAIN.descript:
With great force of will, you push away the Distortion's [purple]corrupting[/purple] influence. But where was your family? Your friends? You needed to get them away from here, away from that maddening performer and its [purple]unholy[/purple] melody.

You see your best friend up ahead. He's smiling at you.

His smile is the last thing you ever see.
RUINA2-THE_PIANIST.pages.SUCCUMB.descrip:
Your mind [red]fractures[/red] and [red]cracks[/red]. This music was so . . . [green]wonderful[/green]. So [green]beautiful[/green]. You can't help but want to get closer, to press your very body against the instrument that could make such [gold]divine[/gold] melodies.

You can't help but want to [sine]evaporate[/sine] into the air like so many of those notes you [green]love[/green].
RUINA2-CHURCH_OF_GEARS.title: Church of Gears
RUINA2-CHURCH_OF_GEARS.pages.INITIAL.des:
[jitter]WHIRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR[/jitter]

You hear bones [red]cracking[/red], blood [red]splattering[/red], and joints [red]breaking[/red]. And through it all, an intense whirring noise fills the air.

The hooded figure next to the noisy machine turns to face you. "Join us, stranger. Join us and be free of your [purple]heavy[/purple] thoughts and worldly burdens!"

The door shuts behind you. It seems they weren't willing to take "no" for an answer.
RUINA2-CHURCH_OF_GEARS.pages.INITIAL.opt: [gold]Transform[/gold] a card, then [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it. Lose [red]{TransformCost}[/red] HP.
RUINA2-CHURCH_OF_GEARS.pages.ACCEPT.desc:
You sit down in the machine, and it feels as if a [purple]vise[/purple] had clamped itself over your head.

The [jitter]whirring[/jitter] noise grows [gold]louder[/gold] and [gold]louder[/gold], the dull pain flares [red]higher[/red] and [red]higher[/red] until suddenly, it all [red]stops[/red].

Your head had never felt lighter.
RUINA2-CHURCH_OF_GEARS.pages.ESCAPE.desc:
You have no intention of subjecting yourself to such a [purple]sinister-looking[/purple] machine.

As the hooded figure steps towards you, you break into a sprint and [red]bulldoze[/red] your way through the huddled figures near the back. Behind you, the sound of [gold]gunshots[/gold] ring out, distracting your would-be pursuers as you dive towards the back exit.

In your haste, you hit your head against the door, making you feel a little [purple]lightheaded[/purple].
RUINA2-R_CORP.title: R Corp
RUINA2-R_CORP.pages.INITIAL.description:
Gunfire [jitter]ripped[/jitter] across the field. The commander watched on in silence as her subordinate's clones killed each other for [gold]dominance[/gold].

"Hey, how much do you want to bet that the little rabbit over there is going to win?"

"That one seems a little too cowardly to grasp victory. The one on a [red]killing spree[/red] seems much more likely to be the victor."

There were only a few clones left. And with a flash of steel, it was over. The [gold]winner[/gold] was -
RUINA2-R_CORP.pages.KILLER.description:
"It appears my deduction was correct. So I suppose that means the next round of drinks is on you, Maxim."

"Damnit! I thought that one looked wily enough to survive, but I guess not."

As the others bickered, the commander simply looked on impassively. For she knew that it was likely that they would all be replaced someday.
RUINA2-R_CORP.pages.COWARD.description:
"Hah! I guess running isn't always such a bad option for a rabbit, is it?"

"I didn't think such a passive variant of Myo could win; I suppose it’s my loss then."

As the others bickered, the commander simply looked on impassively. For she knew that it was likely that they would all be replaced someday.
RUINA2-LANGUAGE.title: Floor of Language
RUINA2-LANGUAGE.pages.INITIAL.descriptio:
"Are you really a lowly Grade 9 Fixer?"

The man in front of her coughed, waving away the [purple]smoke[/purple] from her cigar. "It's the truth, I swear! Why are you so skeptical?"

"Gut feeling. But if you really are bottom of the barrel, that means you'd be grateful to be trained by me, a former [gold]Color[/gold] of the City, right?"

". . . I just remembered I have an appointment with Netzach -"

"No, you don't." She grabs him before he can run off.
RUINA2-LANGUAGE.pages.CROSS_SWORDS.descr:
He eyes her greatsword, the [purple]eyeballs[/purple] embedded in the grotesque blade staring back at him in turn. "Are you really going to use that monster of a thing on me?"

She hefts her weapon, relishing in the [gold]familiar[/gold] feeling. "Don't worry, it's not like you're going to die. Not permanently, anyway."

"That doesn't make me feel any better!"
RUINA2-LANGUAGE.pages.TRAIN_EGO.descript:
A familiar [red]burning[/red] feeling fills her body, and once it abated, she was once again clad in the [purple]terrifying[/purple] visage that earned her Color.

"Hey, wait, I thought you were going to show me how to do that!"

"I just did, didn't I? Now, hurry up and manifest yours before I split you in half."

That day, she learned that Roland had a very colorful vocabulary. She would have to add some of the lesser-known words to the language books later.
RUINA2-ZWEI_ASSOCIATION.title: Zwei Association
RUINA2-ZWEI_ASSOCIATION.pages.INITIAL.de:
"Our [red]casualty[/red] rates have [jitter]skyrocketed[/jitter] over the past few months. This level of attrition is unsustainable; at this rate, our [gold]Association[/gold] will cease to be [gold]relevant[/gold]!"

The woman pounds her fist on the table. "Something needs to be done. Either we make efforts to [gold]improve[/gold] our training and equipment, or we make efforts to scout out these [purple]monstrosities[/purple] before facing them."
RUINA2-ZWEI_ASSOCIATION.pages.INITIAL.op: Lose [red]{ScoutingCost}[/red] Max HP. Obtain an [gold]EGO[/gold] card reward.
RUINA2-ZWEI_ASSOCIATION.pages.TRAINING.d:
"Very good. I'll make plans for a new training regimen immediately."

The meeting adjourns, and you find yourself finally free of a [gold]memory[/gold] that was not yours.
RUINA2-ZWEI_ASSOCIATION.pages.SCOUTING.d:
"Very well then. I will lead the first expedition myself."

The meeting adjourns, and you find yourself finally free of a [gold]memory[/gold] that was not yours.
RUINA2-SOCIAL_SCIENCES.title: Floor of Social Sciences
RUINA2-SOCIAL_SCIENCES.pages.INITIAL.des:
You see a [blue]blue[/blue]-haired man pouring a drink. Despite his apparently [gold]normal[/gold] look, you can't help but wonder if this is a trick of one of the [red]monsters[/red].

"Ah, a guest! You don't look like one of the librarians here, but that's no reason to be a rude host! Come, allow me to pour you a drink."

His calm demeanor and [green]pleasant[/green] attitude win you over. You sit yourself down at the table.
RUINA2-SOCIAL_SCIENCES.pages.DRINK.descr:
The drink was soothing, like relaxing after a long day of work.

You wish this moment could last [gold]forever[/gold].
RUINA2-NOTHING_THERE.title: Nothing There
RUINA2-NOTHING_THERE.pages.INITIAL.descr:
You hear joints [red]twisting[/red] and [red]breaking[/red] up ahead, like someone was trying to contort their body into an [purple]unnatural[/purple] position.

Peeking around the corner, you see a [purple]grotesque[/purple] figure toying with the bodies of several fallen figures. More bodies littered the ground nearby, victims of this horrid [purple]monstrosity[/purple].

As tragic as this scene was, you wouldn't pass up the chance to take some of the spoils of this battle for yourself.
RUINA2-NOTHING_THERE.pages.FAR.descripti:
You quickly dart forward, snatching the first valuable-looking [gold]trinket[/gold] you see. But despite your best attempts at stealth, the creature still turns and snarls at you.

A blinding [purple]headache[/purple] assaults you. Indistinct words pound against your brain, trying to turn your head into mush.

Hello. Goodbye. hElLo. GoOdByE. [jitter]HELLo![/jitter] [jitter]GOOdBYe![/jitter]

Despite the pounding headache, your feet manage to carry you away from that twisted creature. But no matter how far you run, you can't get those [purple]words[/purple] out of your head.
RUINA2-NOTHING_THERE.pages.NEAR.descript: You're not going to risk getting any closer to that creature. The [gold]wealth[/gold] in the pockets of the fallen around you are good enough for you.
RUINA2-WIZARD_OF_OZ.title: Wizard of Oz
RUINA2-WIZARD_OF_OZ.pages.INITIAL.descri:
As you navigate the twists and turns of the labyrinthic  library, you come across a [gold]curious[/gold] book with a [gold]curious[/gold] cover. It flies open before you, pulling you into an [purple]otherworldly[/purple] scene.

A [gold]wizard[/gold] spoke to a group of travelers:
"Scarecrow who seeks [gold]wisdom[/gold] - I will give you a brand-new brain, full of pins and needles!"
"Woodsman who seeks a [gold]heart[/gold] - I will give you a silk heart stuffed with saw-dust!"
"Lion who seeks [gold]courage[/gold] - I will give you a drought filled with boundless courage!"
"Girl who seeks to return [gold]home[/gold] - I will give you a pair of silver shoes that will take you wherever you desire!"

 The [gold]wizard[/gold] grinned. "All I ask in exchange is that you swear [gold]loyalty[/gold] to me."
You see the travelers look at each other, see them hesitate. Then -
RUINA2-WIZARD_OF_OZ.pages.ACCEPT.descrip:
The wizard smiled in [gold]delight[/gold].

"Wonderful! You will all make very fine servants; come closer and receive your presents."
RUINA2-WIZARD_OF_OZ.pages.REFUSE.descrip:
The wizard [purple]frowned[/purple].

"What an insolent lot we have here. To think you would all defy the [gold]mighty[/gold] Wizard of Oz!"

A fight breaks out, but the book closes before you can see what happens to the travelers. Your body throbs [red]painfully[/red], as if you had experienced that [red]heart-racing[/red] battle for yourself.
RUINA2-MESSENGER.title: Messenger of the Index
RUINA2-MESSENGER.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
Another day, another Prescript delivered to some poor, [purple]hapless[/purple] soul.

Sneak [red]needles[/red] into your friend’s birthday cake. [red]Cut[/red] off your right leg and eat it raw. Wave to the first pedestrian you meet on the street.

All of them seemed like such pointless, meaningless Prescripts. But it was his duty to deliver them nonetheless. The Messenger glanced at the final Prescript he was to deliver for the day.

"Take the heart of the one you love."
RUINA2-MESSENGER.pages.DELIVER.descripti:
What a [purple]cruel[/purple], [purple]wretched[/purple] order. It would be so easy for him to replace it with his own fabricated, gentler Prescript. It would be so easy for him to betray the organization he had belonged to for so long.

But today was not that day.

With a [purple]heavy[/purple] heart, he delivered the final Prescript.
RUINA2-MESSENGER.pages.DISCARD.descripti:
What a [purple]cruel[/purple], [purple]wretched[/purple] order. Enough was enough. He was done with following these [purple]absurd[/purple], [purple]vile[/purple] orders. He was done with forcing others to follow these [purple]heinous[/purple], [purple]unspeakable[/purple] commands.

He would grant the people of this City what small [gold]mercy[/gold] he could muster.

Even if [gold]Karma[/gold] would fall on his head for doing so.

Crumpling the final Prescript up, he took out pen and paper and began writing.
RUINA2-GALAXY_CHILD.title: Child of the Galaxy
RUINA2-GALAXY_CHILD.pages.INITIAL.descri:
You spot a small figure, a boy draped in the shining [purple]nebula[/purple] and starry sky of the infinite [purple]galaxy[/purple]. The boy approaches you, holding out a small [gold]bauble[/gold]:

"Won't you be my friend?"
RUINA2-GALAXY_CHILD.pages.ACCEPT.descrip:
You accept the gift, and the boy [gold]beams[/gold] at you.

"It's my [green]gift[/green] to celebrate our [green]friendship[/green]. Please treasure it."
RUINA2-GALAXY_CHILD.pages.REJECT.descrip:
The boy [purple]frowns[/purple], and a small [purple]teardrop[/purple] falls to the ground.

"If you won't keep me company, then I don't need you!"

The [purple]galaxy[/purple] [jitter]rips and distorts[/jitter], and you feel your vision blur as your head pounds in [purple]agony[/purple]. Eventually, the sensation ends, and you feel . . . different. Changed. [purple]Distorted[/purple].
RUINA2-FUNERAL.title: Funeral of the Dead Butterflies
RUINA2-FUNERAL.pages.INITIAL.description:
It sits there amidst a field of butterflies, a silent guardian for those who have [purple]fallen[/purple]. It stands up and offers you its [gold]coffin[/gold], offers you a place to [green]rest[/green] in this strange, chaotic place.

You lie down in the coffin, and the lid closes over you. And as the outside world vanishes, you find yourself [gold]dreaming[/gold] of a place of -
RUINA2-FUNERAL.pages.BLACK.description:
[purple]Violent death[/purple]. It sought out those who did not expect it the most. It surprised them from the [purple]shadows[/purple] and smothered them in [purple]darkness[/purple].

In the dream, you were both predator and prey. And as you awaken with a shout and shaking hands, you feel that a part of you had changed [gold]forever[/gold].
RUINA2-FUNERAL.pages.WHITE.description:
[purple]Quiet death[/purple]. It came to those lying in their beds, weak from age or [purple]sickness[/purple]. It took away their pain, their troubles, their worries - it freed them from the [purple]struggles[/purple] that came with their mortal coil.

Slowly, you awaken from the place of unnatural [gold]tranquility[/gold]. But as your eyes open and your hands push open the lid, you can't help but feel that you had left something behind in that place.
RUINA2-SNOW_WHITE_APPLE.title: Snow White's Apple
RUINA2-SNOW_WHITE_APPLE.pages.INITIAL.de:
You find yourself in a [purple]strange[/purple] [green]forest[/green], dreary and damp. You find a bizarre creature, made of branch and root, waiting for you in the middle of a clearing.

It offers you an [gold]apple[/gold].
RUINA2-SNOW_WHITE_APPLE.pages.ACCEPT.des: You bite into the [gold]apple[/gold]. It tastes [green]sweet[/green], but as you peer into the apple's core, you realize it had been [purple]rotten[/purple] all along.
RUINA2-SNOW_WHITE_APPLE.pages.REJECT.des: The creature [purple]frowns[/purple], and it screeches at you in an overwhelming display of [purple]malice[/purple]. You turn and run, but even after you’ve long left the forest, you still feel as though that creature’s [purple]malicious[/purple] intent lingered with you.
RUINA2-DER_FREISCHUTZ.title: Der Freischütz
RUINA2-DER_FREISCHUTZ.pages.INITIAL.desc:
You see a cloaked figure shrouded in [purple]darkness[/purple]. [red]Bloody[/red] bodies litter the ground around the figure, the remnants of a gruesome [red]massacre[/red].

"The [purple]Devil[/purple] proposed a childish contract to me. My last bullet would puncture the head of my beloved. But I have swindled the [purple]Devil[/purple], for you see, I have already killed all the people I love!"

The figure [jitter]laughed[/jitter], and you could tell that he had already gone [purple]mad[/purple] with power.

"How about it, stranger? How would you like to partake of this contract of mine as well?"
RUINA2-DER_FREISCHUTZ.pages.ACCEPT.descr:
You felt something [red]sear[/red] itself into your soul as the power of the [purple]Devil[/purple] flowed through you. You felt giddy, unrestrained, uncontrollable.

The figure grinned. "Excellent. Now, let us fall into the depths of [red]Hell[/red] together!"
RUINA2-DER_FREISCHUTZ.pages.REJECT.descr:
"How [purple]unfortunate[/purple]. It seems you will simply be another one of my targets, then."

The figure fired at you, but a quick dodge from you turned the bullet into merely a grazing shot. As you ran away from the crazed gunman, you couldn't help but feel relieved that you had avoided whatever [purple]curse[/purple] turned the man from a professional hunter into a [red]bloodthirsty[/red] killer.
RUINA2-WARP_TRAIN.title: Warp Train
RUINA2-WARP_TRAIN.pages.INITIAL.descript:
The train station is crowded as usual, commuters [jitter]rushing[/jitter] from platform to platform, hurrying to get to work on time. As one of the passengers boards the train, you notice a strange looking cube drop from their pocket.

It glows with a [blue]fluorescent[/blue] radiance, and on further observation, you spot a coin slot on it.

Next to the dropped cube, you also notice various stacks of wooden crates, hastily fashioned next to the platform.
RUINA2-WARP_TRAIN.pages.OPEN.description:
You easily [red]break[/red] the locks on the wooden crates, and it seems that the employees were so busy with their packed shifts that they forgot to ensure the [green]protection[/green] of the [gold]goods[/gold] being transported.

Inside the crates, [gold]gold[/gold] pours forth again and again, and you try to pocket as much as you can carry.

Finally, you leave, significantly [gold]wealthier[/gold] than you once were.
RUINA2-WARP_TRAIN.pages.INTERACT.descrip:
You insert some of your [gold]gold[/gold] into the cube, and it glows [gold]brighter[/gold] than before. It begins to pulsate in your hand, faster and faster, as your vision becomes obscured by the radiance of the cube.

You feel time slow down as you watch the scurrying commuters pace slower and slower, until time crawls to a halt, and you begin to [jitter]shudder[/jitter] with the possibilities of what can be done with this power.
RUINA2-SHI_ASSOCIATION.title: Shi Association
RUINA2-SHI_ASSOCIATION.pages.INITIAL.des:
She glanced at the papers crowding her desk. Over a dozen requests, all directed to her group. A lesser director would have long since been [purple]buried[/purple] under their weight.

The door to her office opened, and her [purple]weary[/purple] subordinates entered. "Director . . . we've been dealing with [purple]Urban Nightmare-class[/purple] cases for ten consecutive days. We shouldn't be getting more than one case a week!"

She was right, of course. The sudden deluge of work was unusual, and she had her suspicions as to why the head of the [gold]South Section[/gold] had inflicted such a burden on them.

She glanced at the [gold]invitation[/gold] on her desk, an innucuous-looking thing. There wasn't much time left before she had to take a gamble.
RUINA2-SHI_ASSOCIATION.pages.RUSH.descri:
They were out of time. Tarrying any longer would just subject her subordinates to more requests that would sap them of their [gold]strength[/gold].

"This is the only chance we have and the only time we might be able to gain an [gold]advantage[/gold] out of their request. Gather up the ones who can still move and fight. We don't want to bring anyone who will only prove to be a [purple]burden[/purple] there."

"Understood!"

Her subordinates filed out, their [gold]trust[/gold] and [gold]conviction[/gold] in her plan evident in their movements. She could only pray that she wouldn't end up letting them down.
RUINA2-SHI_ASSOCIATION.pages.PREPARE.des:
She tried to set aside time for [gold]preparation[/gold], but it ended up being a [purple]futile[/purple] endeavor. The pressure from the head of the [gold]South Section[/gold] grew to be too much, and they were forced to leave prematurely.

The fate of her little group . . . was now recorded in a [gold]book[/gold] alongside many others.
RUINA2-NIGHT_IN_THE_BACKSTREETS.title: Night in the Backstreets
RUINA2-NIGHT_IN_THE_BACKSTREETS.pages.IN:
When night falls in the Backstreets, a different world unfolds, and [jitter]they will come[/jitter].

You observe as a [purple]torrential wave[/purple] of sweepers march onward, unflinching in their approach. Various sweepers lay on the ground, left behind from the marching pack, their corpses motionless from fights with stray [gold]Fixers[/gold].

You notice small canisters of red fluids, the life-force of the sweepers, still intact on the ground, and you begin to wonder if you could extract them and harness their [gold]power[/gold] yourself.
RUINA2-NIGHT_IN_THE_BACKSTREETS.pages.EX:
You wait for the stream of sweepers to dissipate before making your move. It doesn't take much effort to reach the streets where the lifeless corpses lay, and you manage to easily unfasten the canister from its host.

But as you fasten the canister to yourself, you stumble and fall, [purple]injuring[/purple] yourself in the process.
RUINA2-NIGHT_IN_THE_BACKSTREETS.pages.OB:
Unsure if the canisters would even work to help yourself, you decide to remain [gold]vigilant[/gold] and keep observing the marching sweepers.

You watch how they scavenge for [green]sustenance[/green], how they sustain themselves in these [purple]dreary[/purple] backstreets.

After 80 minutes of marching, the sweepers dissipate once-more, and you take the opportunity to use your new-found knowledge to do some [gold]scavenging[/gold] of your own.
RUINA2-ART.title: Floor of Art
RUINA2-ART.pages.INITIAL.description:
The Floor of Art. It was a magnificent floor, filled with [gold]grand[/gold] paintings, [gold]picturesque[/gold] scenes . . . and the stench of [purple]alcohol[/purple].

Someone yawned loudly, a sleepy figure half-hidden by stacks of books.

"Hey, wanna be a bro and bring me that beer from over there?"

The figure shamelessly makes this request. In the distance, you see a couple other librarians grappling with a restless [purple]Abnormality[/purple] while this one lazed about.
RUINA2-ART.pages.BRING_DRINK.description:
You walk back with the drink in hand and pass it over. The figure quickly snatches it from your hand and gulps it down.

"Ahhh, that hits the spot!" He grins at you, [green]giddy[/green] and [purple]drunk[/purple]. "Hey, you seem like a nice sort, wanna drink this with me?"

The two of you wile the time away in a [purple]drunken[/purple] stupor, ignoring the nearby [red]commotion[/red].
RUINA2-ART.pages.CUT_SUPPLY.description:
You walk over to the drink, pick it up, and [jitter]throw[/jitter] it away in a nearby trash bin.

"Hey! Why did you [purple]waste[/purple] a perfectly good drink like that?" the figure shouts in indignation.

You tell him that drinking could wait until after the floor didn't have an ongoing [red]incident[/red].

"That feisty [purple]Abnormality[/purple]? It's not even that [red]dangerous[/red]. And it's not like we'd die for good if we're killed. Those assistants should be able to take care of it," he grumbles.

Regardless, the two of you head over to help suppress the [purple]Abnormality[/purple].

It ended up being much more [red]dangerous[/red] than expected.
RUINA2-YOUR_BOOK.title: Your Book
RUINA2-YOUR_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
As you navigate the twists and turns of this library’s labyrinth, you spot a strange book poking out one of the bookshelves.

It has your [gold]name[/gold] on it. Against your better judgment, you find your curiosity piqued, and you go to read the book. As you flip open its pages, you find details of yourself experiencing encounters you do not remember, [green]living[/green] and [red]dying[/red] against foes that you do not recall.

The book seems [purple]endless[/purple]. Every page you turn, you live and die. Live and die. [jitter]Live and die[/jitter]. Despite your lack of recollection about these events, you cannot help but feel that all these pages spoke [gold]truth[/gold].

You can’t help but feel mounting despair at the idea that your story inevitably leads to [purple]death[/purple]. And in the end, you –
RUINA2-YOUR_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.options.O: Obtain a random [gold]Upgraded EGO[/gold] card. Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP.
RUINA2-YOUR_BOOK.pages.OVERCOME.descript:
In the depths of your [purple]despair[/purple], you cling onto a [green]glimmer[/green] of [gold]hope[/gold]. You cling to the thought that surely, one day you will break out of this cycle of life and death.

You feel your resolve harden and [gold]manifest[/gold], and you feel that you had become stronger through this experience.
RUINA2-YOUR_BOOK.pages.SUCCUMB.descripti:
Your [purple]despair[/purple] bubbles up to your throat, [red]choking[/red] you with its weight. You feel a cold [blue]chill[/blue] spread throughout your body, something [purple]hollow[/purple] permeating your very being and shaping your very self.

There is no hope. There is no escape.

After all, there is no conclusion more natural than [purple]death[/purple].
RUINA2-INDEX.title: The Index
RUINA2-INDEX.pages.INITIAL.description:
The machine [jitter]thrummed[/jitter] in rhythm with the heartbeat of the [gold]City[/gold]. Every footstep caused the machine to [jitter]shudder[/jitter], every off-hand comment caused it to [jitter]rotate[/jitter], every wayward deed displaced its pen a little.

The [gold]Weaver[/gold] thought it was [green]beautiful[/green]. The City was creating [gold]Prescripts[/gold] for its people to follow, like a parent giving instructions to their children.

But she was not a part of that. As a [gold]Weaver[/gold], it was her duty to prepare Prescripts, not to receive them. Yet she desperately wished to be the recipient of one of these [gold]heavenly[/gold] messages.
RUINA2-INDEX.pages.SWIPE.description:
It wouldn't hurt if she took one for herself, right? She was a child of the [gold]City[/gold] too. It was her right!

Swiping the next [gold]Prescript[/gold] the machine printed out, she looked at what instruction the [gold]City[/gold] had for her.

"Do not go home until you finish reading the value of e."
RUINA2-INDEX.pages.RESIST.description: No. She had to resist the [purple]temptation[/purple]. There was a reason she was chosen to be a [gold]Weaver[/gold]. For the sake of the [gold]City[/gold], she had to continue faithfully fulfilling her duty.
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.title: Singing Machine
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.INITIAL.des:
You hear something [red]grinding[/red] in the distance, [red]crunching[/red] and [red]munching[/red] on something distinctly [red]fleshy[/red]. You approach closer and find a [red]bloody[/red] machine, moving in rhythm to its own [purple]hideous[/purple] beat.

A person with a looser grip on their sanity might even think this sound was musical.

The machine pauses and opens up, giving you an opportunity to throw something in.
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.GOOD_OFFERI: The machine churns, lets off a [green]happy[/green] little jingle, then . . .
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.BAD_OFFERIN: The machine churns, lets out an [red]angry[/red] rumbling, then . . .
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.UPGRADED_CA: . . . spits the offering back out. You pick it back up, and although it’s [red]bloodstained[/red] now, you sense that it has become [gold]improved[/gold], somehow.
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.DUPE_CARD.d: . . . spits the offering back out. You pick it back up and realize that there seems to be two of them now.
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.RELIC.descr: . . . spits out a [gold]bauble[/gold] covered in [red]blood[/red]. You pick it up, and while you do not recognize the trinket, you sense that it’ll be helpful down the road.
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.POTIONS.des: . . . spits out several [red]blood-covered[/red] flasks. You pick up the flasks, and while your common sense argues against imbibing something produced by this machine, your instincts tell you that these flasks do contain [gold]power[/gold].
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.CURSE.descr: . . . spits your offering back out. It seems it didn't appreciate what you had given it.
RUINA2-SINGING_MACHINE.pages.LOSE_HP.des: . . . spits out a stream of [red]blood[/red], colliding with your face and knocking you over. It seems it didn't appreciate what you had given it.
RUINA2-LOWELL.title: Lowell's Dilemma
RUINA2-LOWELL.pages.INITIAL.description:
"I have a problem."

She gulped. That didn't sound good.

"My [gold]anniversary[/gold] with [gold]Xiao[/gold] is coming up soon, and I still can't decide on what to do for it."

Never mind. The Director was just being a [purple]worrywart[/purple] as usual.

"Surely you have some ideas in mind?"

"I thought about buying something [green]cute[/green] for her. Or maybe I should improve her armaments for her. We are a combat-based Association, after all. What do you think?"
RUINA2-LOWELL.pages.CUTE.description:
"I think you should get her something [green]cute[/green]. It's the more [gold]sentimental[/gold] gesture, and I think she would welcome a reprieve from the [red]blood[/red] and [red]iron[/red] of our work."

The Director nodded. "You're absolutely right. There was a nice plushie I spotted in the Nest; it'll be the perfect gift for her!"

As the Director rushed out to make his purchase, she sighed in relief. Crisis averted.
RUINA2-LOWELL.pages.PRACTICAL.descriptio:
"I think you should improve her [gold]armaments[/gold] for her. It's the more practical gesture and far more likely to be [green]beneficial[/green] to her in our line of work."

The Director nodded. "You're absolutely right. I hear the [gold]Stigma Workshop[/gold] is having a sale right now; their weaponry will be the perfect gift for her!"

As the Director rushed out to make his purchase, she sighed in relief. Crisis averted.
RUINA2-HANA_ASSOCIATION.title: Hana Association
RUINA2-HANA_ASSOCIATION.pages.INITIAL.de:
She glanced at the report, sighing. "Another office has fallen to this [purple]Urban Nightmare[/purple]. We'll need to classify it as a [gold]Star of the City[/gold] now."

Her colleague grimaced. "More needless [red]deaths[/red]. If we had investigated and classified this [purple]hazard[/purple] properly from the start, offices like these would not fall prey to threats beyond their league!"

"I've told you before, but we do not have the time, resources, or manpower to investigate every hazard in the City ourselves."

She could see him hesitate. Finally, he spoke up with a scowl -
RUINA2-HANA_ASSOCIATION.pages.MYSELF.des:
"The hazard is a [gold]Star of the City[/gold] now, right? That means it's worthy of our attention. I'll go and handle it, so no one else falls victim to it!"

He storms out of the room, and she doesn't try to stop him.
RUINA2-HANA_ASSOCIATION.pages.YOU.descri:
"Fine. It's too late to save those offices now, so I'll leave it to you to make sure no one else takes on a threat they can't handle."

He storms out of the room, and she doesn't try to stop him.
RUINA2-DISTORTED_YAN.title: Yan's Futile Struggle
RUINA2-DISTORTED_YAN.pages.INITIAL.descr:
It was [purple]pointless[/purple] all along.

He thought he had been making a difference. He thought he had been [gold]rebelling[/gold] against the [gold]Prescripts[/gold], throwing a wrench in the machinations churning behind the scenes.

But even his rebellion had been accounted for. Even his defiance had been planned for.

In the end, he had been nothing more than another gear spinning within the wheels.

Someone like him should just give in and do as he's told.
RUINA2-DISTORTED_YAN.pages.INITIAL.optio: Obtain an [gold]Upgraded EGO[/gold] card reward. Receive [red]{Curse}[/red].
RUINA2-DISTORTED_YAN.pages.GIVE_IN.descr:
Something inside him [purple]cracked[/purple], [purple]fractured[/purple].

His thoughts changed, restructured, [jitter]twisted[/jitter] into a single, perfect moment of [gold]clarity[/gold].

Nothing mattered anymore. Nothing, except carrying out the [gold]City's[/gold] will.
RUINA2-DISTORTED_YAN.pages.GIVE_UP.descr:
There was still another [gold]path[/gold] left to him. A [gold]path[/gold] that he should've taken long ago when he first received the [gold]Prescript[/gold] to become a [gold]Messenger[/gold].

He didn't care if this would be part of another plan of the Prescripts. He didn't care if even this action would not truly be of his own free will.

He just didn't care anymore.

Raising his sword, he pointed it at himself.
RUINA2-PHILOSOPHY.title: Floor of Philosophy
RUINA2-PHILOSOPHY.pages.INITIAL.descript:
"You're not supposed to be here."

The stern-looking woman takes a sip of [gold]tea[/gold] and sighs as she places it back down. "If I were interested in doing my job properly, I'd [red]chase[/red]  you out. But luckily for you, I can't be bothered to do so at the moment. So why don't you join me for a cup of [gold]tea[/gold] instead?"
RUINA2-PHILOSOPHY.pages.ACCEPT.descripti:
You sit down and take a sip of the [gold]tea[/gold]. It tastes rather [purple]strange[/purple] to you.

"So, how is it? Enjoying the flavor?"

Looking at the woman's [gold]expectant[/gold] expression, you decide that [gold]discretion[/gold] is truly the better part of [gold]valor[/gold] and praise the tea's quality.
RUINA2-PHILOSOPHY.pages.REJECT.descripti:
"Well, that's too bad I suppose."

The floor rumbles and shakes, strange [gold]pillars[/gold] rising out of the ground near her.

"I'll give you a ten second head-start. After that . . . well, you better pray that you can run faster than a [red]speeding pillar[/red]."

You've never booked it faster than you have in this moment.
RUINA2-THUMB.title: The Thumb
RUINA2-THUMB.pages.INITIAL.description:
He glanced at the [purple]miscreant[/purple] who had just walked in: a common Fixer from the common Backstreets.

"You da [gold]boss[/gold] here? I got a great offer -"

A set of steel knuckles [jitter]caves[/jitter] the man's face in, leaving him rolling on the floor, howling in [red]agony[/red].

"Tell your boss that if he wishes to negotiate with me, he should come himself or not at all."

As the [gold]rat[/gold] is tossed out, his assistant steps forward.

"Sir. Our supplies are running low. Shall we purchase more, or would you like us to raid that rat's Office instead?"
RUINA2-THUMB.pages.INITIAL.options.SUPPL: Choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of [blue]{NumCards}[/blue] random [gold]Uncommon[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
RUINA2-THUMB.pages.SUPPLIES.selectionScr: Choose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Uncommon[/gold] Card to Add to Your [gold]Deck[/gold].
RUINA2-THUMB.pages.SUPPLIES.description:
"Make the purchase. I think the rat's boss knows what will happen if he crosses us again."

His subordinate nods, rushing out to fulfill his order. Just as things should be.
RUINA2-THUMB.pages.RAID.description:
"Raid them. Show them what happens to anyone who crosses the [gold]Thumb[/gold]."

His subordinates rush about, preparing themselves for war. For they were his peasants, and he their king.
RUINA2-CRYING_CHILDREN.title: The Crying Children
RUINA2-CRYING_CHILDREN.pages.INITIAL.des:
Everything [red]burned[/red]. Your home, your family, your friends . . . they had all been caught in a mighty [red]conflagration[/red] that had manifested in the blink of an eye.

Someone was crying. But it was not you, the tragic [purple]victim[/purple]. No, it was the [purple]criminal[/purple] who wept, the [purple]perpetrator[/purple] who sobbed with every stroke of [red]fire[/red] that leapt forward from their fingers.

What a twisted joke. An equally fiery [red]rage[/red] burned within you, just waiting to be released. You -
RUINA2-CRYING_CHILDREN.pages.INITIAL.opt: [gold]Transform[/gold] a card into a random [gold]EGO[/gold] card. Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP.
RUINA2-CRYING_CHILDREN.pages.UNLEASH.des:
The world shifts, becoming [purple]blurry[/purple] and [purple]distorted[/purple]. You do not know who you are. You do not know where you are. All you know is that a [purple]crying child[/purple] is in front of you . . . 

And you desperately wish to [red]kill[/red] it.
RUINA2-CRYING_CHILDREN.pages.SUPPRESS.de:
The [red]rage[/red] abates, leaving you feeling drained and empty. A hollow [purple]emptiness[/purple] fills you, sharp and silent just like that child's tears.

There was nothing here for you anymore.
RUINA2-ENSEMBLE.title: Reverberation Ensemble
RUINA2-ENSEMBLE.pages.INITIAL.descriptio:
"Ohohohoho! Knock, and the door shall open!"

"The entrance to this place was super strong, even after many blows we barely got inside."

"It's a test of endurance, after all! There's no use giving up after a couple of knocks!"

"Now friends, if you're any rowdier we might scare away the residents of this place. It would be wise that we show the utmost respect so they don't go hiding behind bookshelves, no?"
RUINA2-ENSEMBLE.pages.INITIAL.options.LE: Claim victory and end the run.
RUINA2-ENSEMBLE.pages.MAKE_A_STAND.descr:
You don't know what compelled you to do so, to risk your very [gold]life[/gold] for a place such as this. But you could tell there was a [gold]Light[/gold] here, a ray of hope that these villains sought to [purple]defile[/purple].

And you would not stand for it.
